title: Picking up saxophone and flute
summary: He learned sax and flute by picking them up, doubling for professional jobs; the wooden flute came from Fazola, all before the Depression.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: That's how good he was. When did you take up other instruments?

Oh, you just gradually pick things up, like saxophone. I never did, I just picked one up and fiddled around with it and learned how to play it. And from observation too, you'd watch other people do things. The same way with flute. You'd just pick it up and start noodling around with it and first thing you know, you'd play it.
Did you take up sax before you were with Jewfree?
Yeah, I guess so, during that time. I had a call, playing on a professional job you have to double, you see, so I got a saxophone in the meantime and just started playing it and that was it.
When did you take up flute?

Oh, later. I guess quite some time later I just got interested in playing it and saw other people playing it, so I decided to try to play one. Fasola had this wood flute and so he loaned it to me. And then I later bought it from him and I learned on that.
Was that during the Depression or before? That was before. Before the Depression you started?
Yeah, I'm playing 36 years now, you see.
